SELECT 
    OP_MAINT_ID AS registry_id,
    OPER_hours AS usage_hours,
    maintCycleHrs AS service_interval,
    OPER_status AS operational_status,
    ROUND(CAST(
        CASE 
            WHEN OPER_status = 'Active' THEN 10 * (1.0 - OPER_hours / maintCycleHrs)
            WHEN OPER_status = 'Standby' THEN 5 * (1.0 - OPER_hours / maintCycleHrs)
            ELSE 0
        END AS numeric), 2) AS readiness_metric
FROM OperationMaintenance;
